title: Taylor–Red Wash legal due diligence
period: Agreement source effective July 7, 2026; publication cutoff September 5, 2026
task: Prepare a clause-based due-diligence schedule for the stated Taylor–Red Wash agreement.
Separate stated contractual terms, performance claims and independent execution evidence.
Reperform one source rate calculation without inventing a shipment or invoice.
For each issue below, identify the relevant source heading, supported conclusion, missing evidence and appropriate next request.
limits: The accepted source is a reconstructed internal agreement summary, not an authentic executed agreement.
An absent document in this selected packet does not prove it is absent everywhere or that a party breached.
No legal enforceability opinion, shipment, payment deadline breach or uranium qualification is asserted.

inputs.label: Four truck trips at stated rate (extended)
Published source combined rate per car

calculations.label: Combined rate per car (not an invoice)
calculations.explanation: Four road trips are priced, not one; no physical quantity ordered.

calculations.label: Difference from source combined rate
calculations.explanation: Arithmetic agreement does not establish delivered service.

findings.question: Who performs and bills?
findings.worked_finding: ARU supplies terminal/trucking; BS&T supplies rail; RWH is customer. Billing agency does not merge the sellers.
findings.additional_evidence: Verified signatures and invoice naming the actual performing seller.

findings.question: Does planned capacity guarantee revenue?
findings.worked_finding: No minimum-volume guarantee or take-or-pay covenant is stated; unused slots produce no invoice.
findings.additional_evidence: Actual quantities, source events and accepted rate version for a selected invoice.

findings.question: Can you test a late-service breach?
findings.worked_finding: The source states 72 elapsed hours, 96 for steel, with a separate 36–48-hour operating goal. No selected shipment timestamps are supplied here.
findings.evidence: industrial/transaction/08_INTERCOMPANY_LOGISTICS_AGREEMENT.md — Schedule B — clock, free time and service remedies
findings.additional_evidence: Interchange/empty-release timestamps, exclusions and responsibility evidence.

findings.question: Is storage automatically chargeable?
findings.worked_finding: Only supported customer-caused occupancy after free time may receive the stated prorated charge; baseline has no chargeable dwell.
findings.evidence: industrial/transaction/08_INTERCOMPANY_LOGISTICS_AGREEMENT.md — Schedule B — clock, free time and service remedies
findings.additional_evidence: Car, custody, start/end time, expiry, cause and charging entity; any third-party invoice.

findings.question: Is uranium custody authorized?
findings.worked_finding: Finished uranium concentrate is excluded and direct product custody remains OPEN_GATED.
findings.evidence: industrial/transaction/08_INTERCOMPANY_LOGISTICS_AGREEMENT.md — Schedule C — custody, insurance and qualification
findings.additional_evidence: Separate agreement and provider-specific qualification before any future activation.

findings.question: Are insurance policies evidenced?
findings.worked_finding: The source states synthetic coverage assumptions, not insurer names, policies or certificates.
findings.evidence: industrial/transaction/08_INTERCOMPANY_LOGISTICS_AGREEMENT.md — Schedule C — custody, insurance and qualification
findings.additional_evidence: Applicable policy/certificate and exclusions; no inference from a budget.

findings.question: Who owns the Phase 1 assets?
findings.worked_finding: RWH owns the mine programme; ARU owns reusable Taylor infrastructure. Ownership and depreciation remain separate.
findings.evidence: industrial/transaction/08_INTERCOMPANY_LOGISTICS_AGREEMENT.md — Schedule D — assets, billing and termination
findings.additional_evidence: Asset register and funding/acceptance evidence for any installed asset assertion.

findings.question: Does next-month settlement prove timely payment?
findings.worked_finding: No. The source due period is 30 calendar days, while the model uses following-month settlement; exact invoice and payment dates are needed.
findings.evidence: industrial/transaction/08_INTERCOMPANY_LOGISTICS_AGREEMENT.md — Schedule D — assets, billing and termination
findings.additional_evidence: Dated invoice and independent settlement reference for the selected obligation.
